records.title: OWL: Optimized Workforce Learning for General Multi-Agent Assistance in Real-World Task Automation
records.reason: OWL is a multi-agent task-automation system and reduces planner training overhead, but reported results do not isolate LLM inference latency, memory, or throughput.

records.title: GDPval: Evaluating AI Model Performance on Real-World Economically Valuable Tasks
records.reason: GDPval is an evaluation benchmark for economically valuable tasks and compares model performance; it does not introduce an inference or serving optimization.

records.title: WebGLM: Towards An Efficient Web-Enhanced Question Answering System with Human Preferences
records.reason: WebGLM reports faster web retrieval (5.3 s average and 4.07 s median) using asynchronous fetching; the measured improvement is retrieval latency, not LLM inference serving.

records.title: Fixed Anchors Are Not Enough: Dynamic Retrieval and Persistent Homology for Dataset Distillation
records.reason: Dynamic retrieval and persistent homology are used for dataset distillation; the method is a training-data/distillation contribution, not an LLM inference efficiency method.

records.title: LongVPO: From Anchored Cues to Self-Reasoning for Long-Form Video Preference Optimization
records.reason: LongVPO is a video preference-optimization/training method, not a video-inference serving optimization.
